_doc: Minimum patched PostgreSQL minor release per supported major, for dbh.01. Update after every PostgreSQL security release (quarterly, plus out-of-cycle) from https://www.postgresql.org/support/versioning/ and https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/. audit_postgres.py warns when 'checked' is more than 120 days old.
release: 2026-11-12: 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, 14.25 (52 CVEs, including CVE-2026-6460, CVSS 8.8, arbitrary code execution via ALTER ... SET DATA TYPE, and CVE-2026-116311, DROP OWNED removing restrictive row security policies); 19.0 released 2026-11-19

cve_extensions.dblink: CVE-2026-120147 (code execution), CVE-2026-14661 (append to arbitrary files)
cve_extensions.pgcrypto: CVE-2026-2005 (code execution), CVE-2026-14663 (silently encrypts to cleartext for OpenSSL-disabled ciphers)
